🎙
Comment
by Aide to the President of Russia Yury Ushakov following Vladimir Putin’s meeting with Special Envoy of the US President Steven Witkoff
(October 21, 2026)
💬
Yury Ushakov
: As always,
today’s discussion
was
substantive and frank
, lasting almost three hours.
Following up on
Vladimir Putin’s
telephone conversation
with
Donald Trump
on October 9, the exchange of views continued on
ways to achieve a lasting and sustainable peace
.
Russia's President
praised the mediation efforts
of the US Administration, Donald Trump personally and his special envoys to find mutually acceptable solutions.
☝️
It is important to note that the possible resumption of trilateral talks involving representatives of Russia, the US and Ukraine was discussed in specific terms
.
As you know,
the Ukrainian regime itself thwarted their planned resumption
immediately after
the State Duma
elections by launching massive strikes on the main voting day against Moscow, other cities, polling stations and election commission staff directly, some of whom were killed.
The situation was reviewed again,
taking into account, among other things, the signals received from the Americans.
Our President informed Steve Witkoff that
we are
, in principle,
ready to resume these trilateral talks between November 10 and 19
, focusing on
👉
the central issue: building a security framework for Russia and Ukraine after the conflict ends
. The American representative said that President Trump would undoubtedly welcome this decision with great satisfaction.
Vladimir Putin asked Steve Witkoff to convey
his gratitude to US First Lady Melania Trump
for her
humanitarian efforts
, particularly in
reuniting children with their families
, as well as for her mediation in resolving
the grave humanitarian situation in the Russian town of Alyoshki
in the Kherson Region.
***
There was also an exchange of views on
the situation in the Middle East
, primarily, of course,
developments surrounding Iran
. Russia reaffirmed its readiness to continue helping to find
political and diplomatic ways
to resolve the Iranian issue.
🇷🇺
🇨🇳
🇺🇸
Naturally, today’s discussion also touched on a matter attracting considerable attention worldwide:
the possible first-ever meeting of the leaders of Russia, China and the US
during
the APEC Summit in Shenzhen
, China, this November.
None of the three capitals
– Moscow, Washington or Beijing –
has rejected this idea
.
Our Chinese friends
,
as hosts of the APEC Summit
,
are already undertaking preparations for it
. If circumstances are favourable, they will, of course, include this meeting in the programme of events in Shenzhen.
We put forward
several practical suggestions
regarding the substance of the possible trilateral talks.

Allow me to extend a cordial welcome to you here in St Petersburg.

Today, you and Prime Minister of Russia Mikhail Mishustin held
the 31st regular meeting of the Russian and Chinese heads of government
. Over its 30 years, this mechanism has proved effective and valuable.
We are grateful for your personal contribution
to developing Russian-Chinese ties and for the constructive approach that your colleagues in the Government of China take to all these matters.
☝️
Overall, I would like to note that relations between Russia and China are developing very successfully and dynamically
. They are based on the principles of equality, mutual respect, mutual benefit and consideration for each other’s interests. Our relations do not depend on the international situation and are not directed against anyone.
Trade and economic ties are growing
, and we will continue to expand practical cooperation in all key areas. We are working together in energy, information technology, space and the peaceful use of nuclear energy.
I would like to highlight the substantial progress in agricultural trade
: turnover
increased by 34%
in the first eight months of 2026.
Cooperation in the humanitarian sphere is also growing stronger
. Events under
the cross Years of Education
, which President Xi Jinping and I
officially launched
in Beijing in May, are proceeding successfully.
I know that a major event in China’s domestic political life –
the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
– will take place next week, on October 26-29.
🤝
I wish our Chinese friends
every success
in holding this important event.

item.title: ⚡️ On October 21, Latvian Chargé d’Affaires a.i. Ramona Krasovska was summoned to the Russian Foreign Ministry.
item.description: ⚡️ On October 21, Latvian Chargé d’Affaires a.i. Ramona Krasovska was summoned to the Russian Foreign Ministry. A strong protest was expressed over the Latvian MFA demand to dismiss all staff of the social welfare office within the Consular Section of the Russian Embassy in Riga . This jeopardises pension payments and social support for nearly 6,000 Russian military pensioners and their family members residing in Latvia. It was stressed that these actions by the Latvian authorities violate the country’s obligations under the 1994 Russian-Latvian intergovernmental agreement on social protection for Russian military pensioners and their families . Russia has always fulfilled its obligations to Russian military pensioners and their family members living in Latvia, rigorously and in full. ❗️ The Latvian authorities bear full responsibility for this artificially created crisis in military pension payments. The Latvian side was strongly urged to strictly observe the letter and spirit of the intergovernmental agreement . A corresponding note from the Russian Foreign Ministry was delivered.

item.title: 🇷🇺 On October 20, Premier of the State Council of the People’s Republic of China Li Qiang

Our governments work closely together through the mechanism of regular meetings between the Heads of Government. World Youth Festival Directorate:
#Announcement
Applications are now open for
the Time of the Young All-Russian Youth Achievement Award
!
Two international nominations
are open for participation of young compatriots and youth organizations abroad:
•
Friend of Russia
— for Russian citizens and compatriots aged 18 to 35 who live and work abroad, bring young people together, implement socially significant initiatives, and strengthen humanitarian ties with Russia. Applicants must have at least three years of project experience.
•
Ambassador of Russia
— for international organizations developing cooperation with Russia, as well as Russian organizations engaged in international activities. This nomination recognizes projects that promote Russian culture, language, and values, and strengthen international youth and humanitarian cooperation.
💬
Deputy Prime Minister of Russia Dmitry Chernyshenko:
The Time of the Young Award, part of the Youth and Children national project, is one of the main awards in Russia’s youth policy.
Over the past five years, it has recognized the achievements of
more than 1,200 people
: those who create opportunities for young people, serve society, develop socially significant projects, and show that Russia is a country of limitless opportunities.
The winners have been able to scale up their projects, receive informational support, and share their experience with others.
This year, the Award is held in nominations across seven thematic areas.
I invite you to take part!
Deadline for application submission:
November 9, 2026
🏆
The awards ceremony will take place on December 19, 2026, at
the 'RUSSIA' National Centre in Moscow
, bringing together more than 1,000 participants.
